# Disruption with Email Delivery

## What Changed

Nov 12, 21:43 UTC Resolved - This incident has been resolved. Thank you for your patience and understanding as we addressed this issue. A detailed root cause analysis will be shared as soon as it is available. Nov 12, 21:43 UTC Update - We’ve resolved the email-processing impact on our systems and are continuing to monitor. The upstream provider disruption may still cause delays for customers using that provider. Email delivery through other providers is operating normally. Nov 12, 21:02 UTC Update - We’re monitoring an email disruption related to an upstream provider degradation. Users whose email is hosted by the affected provider may experience delays in message delivery. Email service for users on other providers is currently operating normally. We’ll share updates as we learn more. Nov 12, 20:21 UTC Update - We are seeing recovery for sign-in, email address verification, and other forms of e-mail communication previously impacted. We will continue to monitor. Nov 12, 20:19 UTC Monitoring - The degradation has been mitigated. We are monitoring to ensure stability.
